title: Complimentary Wellness Exam for Small Animals, Birds and Reptiles under the Live Pet Health Guarantee
content:
**Rule.** Small animals, birds and reptiles bought with the Live Pet Health Guarantee receive one free wellness exam within the free exam period of their guarantee type after purchase, at a Tailwise Vet Clinic only where the type limits the free exam to a Tailwise Vet Clinic. The exam is not a claim and does not use the guarantee.

## Training questions and answers

**Which animals receive the free exam?**
Small animals, birds and reptiles, that is, animals under the Small Animal Guarantee, the Bird Guarantee and the Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee. The free exam period of the Freshwater Fish, Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate and Live Coral Guarantees is 0, which means no free exam.

**How many free exams come with one purchase?**
One. Once the free exam has been used, it is recorded as used on that guarantee.

**Where is it held?**
Where the guarantee type limits it to a Tailwise Vet Clinic, at a Tailwise Vet Clinic only.

**Does the exam affect the guarantee?**
No. The exam is not a claim and does not use the guarantee: after a free exam the guarantee keeps its status, and the one claim allowed per purchase remains available.

## Hypothetical illustration

A customer buys a parakeet under the Bird Guarantee and takes it for the free wellness exam at a Tailwise Vet Clinic within the free exam period. The guarantee remains active, nothing is booked out of its covered value, and no claim is recorded.
